videos.headline: Aziaha James cashes another Wolfpack 3
videos.description: Aziaha James gets another three-pointer to go as NC State continue to throttle Michigan State.

videos.headline: Saniya Rivers' 17 points, 11 assists fuels NC State to Sweet 16
videos.description: Saniya Rivers stuffs the stat sheet with 17 points, 11 assists and 8 rebounds in the Wolfpack's takedown of Michigan State.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCW Highlights (Saniya Rivers’ almost triple-double fuels NC State to Sweet 16) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.description: Aziaha James blocks Michigan State in the paint, then runs the floor and gets open for the NC State basket.
